findings.evidence: The fix is a two-point comparison (pre-dispatch vs post-run). A write that lands mid-window AND is reverted byte-identically before the post-run read (A-to-B-to-A) passes it: pre==post, record persists, yet part of the suite executed over B. Attack enumeration during this review found no shipped writer class that does byte-identical restores in the project tree (specialists do not revert-to-identical; the L1 suite runs in scratch dirs; bd writes append; workflow-written untracked paths are outside tree_fingerprint by design), so the residual is theoretical under current writers. The in-code comment at :2397 says the comparison fires if EITHER instrument moved WHILE the suite was running — strictly it measures NET movement between the two reads, a slightly narrower claim.
findings.description: Documented-class TOCTOU residual of any two-point read, not a defect: the recorded baseline equals both endpoints of the run window, and the cost direction stays safe (a false persist requires a self-cancelling excursion, never an ordinary concurrent write). Worth one comment-line tightening (moved-between-reads vs moved-while-running) whenever the region is next edited; no fix round warranted.

findings.evidence: The skip-path replay slurps the SAME last-failed-checks/last-runner caches the escalation replay uses, with no green/red branch anywhere in the path; the caches are written regardless of pass/fail (:3929-3943, rm -f only on pass) and record_verified_state is called unconditionally (:3944-3954). Red replay through the SIBLING escalation path is driven by legs E/F; the skip path has green-replay legs (Leg J) and a live red carry-forward was observed by the coordinator this batch. No dedicated leg drives the skip path replaying a RED cached result.
findings.description: Symmetry holds by construction (color-blind mechanism, shared cache, shared branch shape), verified by code read and observed live. A dedicated skip-replays-red leg would be a cheap completeness addition next time escalation-basis is edited; not blocking, and demanding it now would be coverage theatre over a branch that does not exist.
